_comment: LPDDR4 DQ swizzle U501 (Ti135N484) -> U801 (H9HCNNN8KUMLHR-NME). Single source for tools/sheets/08_lpddr4.py
(schematic wiring) and efinity/pinplan/pinplan.py (Interface Designer PIN_SWIZZLE_*). See LPDDR4_SWIZZLE.md.
dq[n][k] = DRAM DQ bit (0-7, within the DRAM byte that FPGA byte n is wired to) on FPGA ball DDR_DQ[8n+k].
FPGA byte 0/1 -> channel A byte 0/1, byte 2/3 -> channel B byte 0/1 (fixed). DM, DQS, CA, CK, CKE, CS are not swapped.
ca[i] = DRAM CA index on FPGA DDR_A[i] (identity: no CA swizzle).
